description: Defines the UpdateCatalogItemRequest class which represents a data transfer object for updating catalog items in the eShopOnWeb project. Contains validation attributes for properties like Id, CatalogBrandId, CatalogTypeId, Description, Name, and Price, along with properties for pictures.

classes.name: UpdateCatalogItemRequest
classes.description: A request DTO derived from BaseRequest used for updating catalog items, including validation rules for various properties.
